title: SIMGUIDE: Procedurally Grounded Multi-Context Representations for Personalized Agent Planning
content:
arXiv:2608.24888v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Personalized AI agents overwhelmingly treat users as single entities: a flat profile concatenated into a prompt. This fails when the same person holds different priorities across life contexts -- and fails catastrophically when those priorities conflict. The core problem is not that agents lack information about users; it is that the format of user representations determines whether an agent can act on that information at all. We introduce SIMGUIDE, a method that structures user context into typed, domain-specific blocks called Sims and grounds each constraint with procedural examples drawn from past decisions. To evaluate this, we construct SIMBENCH, a diagnostic suite of 47 preference-conditioned planning tasks where the correct plan depends on which user context is active -- a property no existing benchmark tests. title: post-graph-rag: A PostgreSQL-Native Graph RAG Engine
content:
arXiv:2608.24921v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation connects facts that no single passage states, but current implementations pay for that three times: in infrastructure, requiring a vector store, graph database and document store to be kept consistent; in graph quality, because an extraction pipeline that never refuses output fills the graph with edges that assert nothing; and over time, because a graph that only accumulates treats superseded and current facts alike.
  post-graph-rag is an open-source engine addressing all three. Text chunks with embeddings, a canonical entity graph and community summaries live in one PostgreSQL database, with pgvector for search and edge tables for traversal. Extraction-time invariants run before anything is written: vague predicates, pronominal names and bare quantities are rejected; predicates are normalised onto an optional vocabulary; entities resolve to one vertex per canonical name via model-supplied alia
author: Chandan Rajah
summary_zh: post-graph-rag 是一个完全构建在 PostgreSQL 之上的开源 Graph RAG 引擎，用 pgvector 做向量检索、用边表做图遍历，将文本块、实体图与社区摘要统一存储，免去了向量库+图数据库+文档库三套系统的一致性维护成本。其亮点在于提取阶段引入不变量校验（拒绝写入无意义边）以及对过时事实的时效性处理，直击传统 Graph RAG 的图质量与知识陈旧问题。

title: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion
content:
arXiv:2608.24979v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scientific agents increasingly analyze data, execute code, and produce research artifacts, yet most benchmarks emphasize final answers, isolated programs, or a single domain. We introduce FrontierChallenge, a cross-domain benchmark comprising 300 end-to-end scientific workflows. In this paper, we release and evaluate 97 of these tasks, spanning quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, materials characterization, analytical chemistry, life science, and electrochemistry/environment. Each task provides fixed inputs and specifies a bundle of required scientific deliverables. We evaluate twelve frontier models with three agent scaffolds. Pass Rate measures the fraction of tasks satisfying the full-completion criterion, while Avg. Score captures partial progress. Each of the best-performing configurations completed only 20 of the 97 released tasks, yielding a Pass Rate of 20.6%. Partial progress translated especially poorly into complete deliver
author: Liangcai Su, Zhaopeng Feng, Zhuo Chen, Zhen Zhang, Xiang Lin, Ruilin Li, Handuo Zhang, Ning Wang, Kailong Wen, Yueqi Guo, Feng Xing, Yiling Guo, Chenxiong Qian, Simon Shaolei Du, Lidong Bing, Xinyu Wang
summary_zh: 论文提出 FrontierChallenge 基准，包含 300 个跨领域端到端科研工作流任务（本次公开 97 个），涵盖量子化学、分子动力学、材料表征、分析化学、生命科学与电化学等方向，要求智能体完成数据分析、代码执行并交付完整科研产出物。作者用 12 个前沿模型搭配 3 种 agent 脚手架进行评测，以「完整交付」通过率而非最终答案正确率为核心指标。对关注 LLM 智能体工作流能力边界与评测方法的人有参考价值。

title: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built
summary_zh: IBM 官方在 HuggingFace Blog 上介绍 Granite 4.2 系列开源大模型的构建过程，涵盖架构设计、训练数据与后训练方法等技术细节。对关注开源模型能力演进、想了解企业级 LLM 如何从零训练的开发者有参考价值，但与 Claude Code 日常使用和编程工作流的直接关联较弱。

title: OpenAI Is Developing a ‘Persistent’ AI Agent
content: Code reviewed by WIRED reveals the company is developing a feature that enables Codex to continue working proactively until it is “put to sleep.”
author: Maxwell Zeff
summary_zh: WIRED 通过审查 OpenAI 的代码发现，公司正在为 Codex 开发「持续运行」的智能体功能，使其能主动持续工作直到被「休眠」。这预示着 AI 编程助手正从「一问一答」向长时间自主运行的后台代理演进，与 Claude Code 的后台任务、长周期 agent 工作流方向一致。

title: I Ran 200+ Prompts on 24 LLMs This Week
author: AI Coding Daily
summary_zh: 作者在一周内对 24 个 LLM 跑了 200+ 条提示词，横向对比各模型在编程等任务上的实际表现。这类大规模实测对比可为模型选型和提示词设计提供参考数据，但内容仅为新闻条目摘要，细节和方法论披露有限。
